scenes.voiceover: You're not lazy. You're just running the wrong operating system.

content.title: Focus Is An Operating System
content.description: Not a personality trait you're missing.

scenes.voiceover: Step one: clear the work surface before you start cooking.

content.title: One: Clear The Surface
items: Close every tab you're not writing into
One window. One doc. One task.

scenes.voiceover: Cal Newport said, clarity about what matters is the foundation of deep work.

content.quote: Clarity about what matters provides clarity about what does not.
content.caption: From Deep Work

scenes.voiceover: Step two: shrink the time slot. Parkinson's law is doing you a favor.

content.title: Two: Shrink The Slot
content.description: Work expands to fill the time you give it.
items: Set a shorter timer than feels safe

scenes.voiceover: Step three: anchor on one verb, not a pile of nouns.

content.title: Three: One Verb, Not Many Nouns
content.description: Tasks are verbs. Pins on a board are nouns.

scenes.voiceover: Naval Ravikant put it bluntly: desire is a contract to be unhappy.

content.quote: Desire is a contract you make with yourself to be unhappy until you get what you want.
content.caption: On the cost of wanting

scenes.voiceover: Step four: log the distraction, don't fight it. Capture it and keep going.

content.title: Four: Capture, Don't Resist
content.description: Writing it down frees the loop your brain is running.
items: Pen and paper to the left of the keyboard
One line per itch, no elaboration
Revisit the list after the timer rings

scenes.voiceover: Four moves, one system. Run it tomorrow before you decide you're broken.

content.title: Run It Tomorrow
content.description: Skills are not traits. They're reps.
